Title: Path of Typhon vs Typhonic Beast

Messages.Author: galliard
Messages.Body:
Hi. My question is more general. There are cards that reduce cost of particular discipline cards. On the other side there are multidiscipline cards. So my question is:

Do i still reduce card cost of Typhonic Beast when Path of Typhon is in play?
This one is tricky and really can be interpreted both ways.

I was wondering can i give Auspex to Gabrin and play Nightmare Curse for free..(with Path of Paradox ofc)

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
It's not tricky. A Typhonic beast require Serpentis, so its cost is lowered by one by the path of Typhon.

Same thing for Nightmare curse with Path of Paradox.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> galliard wrote:
> Hi. My question is more general. There are cards that reduce cost of particular discipline cards. On the other side there are multidiscipline cards. So my question is:
>
> Do i still reduce card cost of Typhonic Beast when Path of Typhon is in play?
>
Yes.
Similarly, Lydia, Grand Praeto cannot play Forced March or Quicken Sight, even with a Celerity discipline card (as both these cards require Celerity).

Name: Lydia, Grand Praetor
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: True Brujah
Group: 6
Capacity: 9
Discipline: dom pre AUS FOR POT TEM
Independent: Lydia has 1 vote (titled). Once each action, she can burn 1 blood for +1 stealth. She cannot play cards that require Celerity [cel]. Scarce.

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Suppose you had Wamukota (Laibon Ravnos with aus CHI) with 3 Orun and also had the Path of Paradox in play (reduce cost of Chimerstry cards by 1 blood). Wamukota could play Shared Nightmare at aus & chi (normally costs 2 blood), followed by High Orun (reduce cost of discipline cards by 1 for the action), effectively for free!
